name: agent-os-workbench
description: Open Olivia's Agent Switch beside your VS Code projects.

agentOS.projectPath.description: Path to the local Olivia's Agent Switch source folder (the folder containing scripts/start-codex-dashboard.mjs). Defaults to the first open VS Code workspace folder.

agentOS.dashboardUrl.description: Local Olivia's Agent Switch dashboard URL. Keep this on loopback; it exposes local agent tools and files.

agentOS.autoStart.description: Start the local dashboard if it is not already running.
